_about: Muscle Group filter (library + exercise picker). An exercise's group = `target`[its dataset target] (primary muscle), else `body_part`[its dataset body_part], else `fallback`. Exercises listed in `full_body` ALSO belong to full_body (compound total-body lifts; the dataset has no such value). `sections` = the three sections of the sheet, in order. Validated by tools/build_catalog.dart (every group known, every dataset target mapped, full_body ids exist) and generated into app/lib/features/exercises/data/exercise_filters_data.dart.

_notes.spine: Erector spinae (hyperextensions, good mornings) → lower back.
_notes.body_part: Only used when a future dataset adds a target this file doesn't know. `back`, `upper arms` and `upper legs` are deliberately absent (they span several groups): such an exercise falls to `other` until mapped.
_notes.full_body: Burpees, cleans, snatches, jerks, thrusters, clean & press, kettlebell swing, Turkish get-up, farmers walk, battling ropes, bear crawl, rope climb, sledge hammer, tire flip, snatch pull, squat jerk. They keep their target group too.
_notes.other: The fallback group: 0 exercises in the current dataset (every target is mapped).
